title: Phase 1 Operation Handoff Checklist
description: Machine-testable operation handoff checklist for Phase 1 local mock delivery. It points operators to local docs, static previews, generated evidence, and allowlisted validation commands.

inputs.description: 真实 SDK 依赖 content read approval 禁用壳，只生成未来依赖文件内容读取审批模型，不读取依赖文件内容、不返回原文、不持久化内容、不写审批产物、不生成 patch、不执行命令、不安装 SDK、不检查密钥。
真实 SDK 依赖 content read plan 禁用壳，只生成未来依赖文件内容读取只读审查计划模型，不读取依赖文件内容、不返回原文、不持久化内容、不写计划产物、不生成 patch、不执行命令、不安装 SDK、不检查密钥。
真实 SDK 依赖 content read final confirmation 禁用壳，只生成未来依赖文件内容只读读取前最终确认模型，不读取依赖文件内容、不返回原文、不持久化内容或确认记录、不写确认产物、不创建执行任务、不授权读取执行、不生成 patch、不执行命令、不安装 SDK、不检查密钥。
真实 SDK 依赖 content read readonly execution，只在最终确认后读取允许名单内本地依赖文件并返回脱敏预览；不返回原文、不持久化内容或记录、不写产物、不生成 patch、不执行命令、不安装 SDK、不检查密钥、不联网。
真实 SDK 依赖 install change proposal，只基于只读脱敏依赖内容预览生成未来安装变更方案模型和不可执行 patch 预览；不写依赖文件、不写 patch 文件、不应用 patch、不物化或执行命令、不安装 SDK、不解析包、不检查密钥、不联网。
真实 SDK 依赖 install execution gate，只基于已审核安装变更方案生成未来安装执行门禁模型；不授权执行、不写依赖文件、不写 patch 文件、不应用 patch、不物化或执行命令、不安装 SDK、不解析包、不检查密钥、不联网。

inputs.description: 真实 SDK 依赖 content read approval 机器契约，约束 dependencyContentReadAuthorized=false、dependencyContentReadExecuted=false、dependencyContentReturned=false、contentReadApprovalArtifactWritten=false、realLlmCalled=false。
真实 SDK 依赖 content read plan 机器契约，约束 dependencyContentReadAuthorized=false、dependencyContentReadExecuted=false、dependencyContentReturned=false、contentReadPlanArtifactWritten=false、realLlmCalled=false。

真实 SDK 依赖 content read final confirmation 机器契约，约束 dependencyContentReadAuthorized=false、dependencyContentReadExecuted=false、dependencyContentReturned=false、contentReadFinalConfirmationArtifactWritten=false、contentReadExecutionTaskCreated=false、contentReadExecutionApprovalGranted=false、realLlmCalled=false。

真实 SDK 依赖 content read readonly execution 机器契约，允许最终确认后的本地只读脱敏预览，并约束 rawDependencyContentReturned=false、dependencyContentPersisted=false、contentReadReadonlyExecutionArtifactWritten=false、commandExecuted=false、dependencyInstallExecuted=false、secretPresenceChecked=false、networkAccess=false、realLlmCalled=false。

handoffItems.title: Read the root project README
handoffItems.expectedSignal: Phase 1 current capabilities and quick validation commands are documented.

handoffItems.title: Read the delivery README
handoffItems.expectedSignal: Input, output, command, test, and limit sections are present.

handoffItems.title: Read the Phase 1 FAQ before handling failed validation
handoffItems.expectedSignal: FAQ covers VALIDATION_ERROR, schema failure, review gate, provider disabled, and unknown Shell risk.

handoffItems.title: Read the local demo runbook
handoffItems.expectedSignal: Runbook only references allowlisted validation commands and manual preview pages.

handoffItems.title: Read the operator demo script checklist
handoffItems.expectedSignal: Checklist defines the demo order from Launchpad through evidence, acceptance, delivery, audit incident review, review gate, and safety boundary.

handoffItems.title: Read the high-risk MCP handoff checklist
handoffItems.expectedSignal: High-risk MCP tools remain review-intent-only or read-only, and real execution remains disabled.

handoffItems.title: Read the final operation signoff package
handoffItems.expectedSignal: Final signoff sequence only references local files, static previews, generated evidence, and allowlisted validation commands.

handoffItems.title: Read the operations manual
handoffItems.expectedSignal: Operations manual explains local preview, allowlisted validation, review gates, generated evidence, and safety limits.

handoffItems.title: Read the operations Skill pack
handoffItems.expectedSignal: Operations Skill pack composes existing Mock Skills, Prompts, Workflows, Schemas, and CLI commands without starting real agents.

handoffItems.title: Read the Standalone Agent delivery package
handoffItems.expectedSignal: Standalone Agent delivery remains a local MOCK_ONLY handoff package and does not connect to a real external platform.

handoffItems.title: Read the access entrypoints delivery package
handoffItems.expectedSignal: Access entrypoints remain local static previews; planned IP and port URLs are disabled placeholders only.

handoffItems.title: Read the Phase 5 mock baseline freeze
handoffItems.expectedSignal: Real LLM PoC cannot start until the frozen mock baseline and entry gates are confirmed.

handoffItems.title: Open the local operations launchpad
handoffItems.expectedSignal: Launchpad shows operator entry cards, validation commands, and MOCK_ONLY safety summary.

handoffItems.title: Open the local access entrypoints page
handoffItems.expectedSignal: Access page shows local static entrypoints, planned disabled ports, and network exposure remains blocked.

handoffItems.title: Open the local operations demo script page
handoffItems.expectedSignal: Demo Script page shows 12 demo steps, acceptance signals, safe commands, blocked actions, and disabled real actions.

handoffItems.title: Open the local operations presenter view
handoffItems.expectedSignal: Presenter View page shows 12 speaker cues, 6 acceptance signals, 8 blocked actions, 137 / 137 delivery readiness, and disabled real actions.

handoffItems.title: Open the local operations signoff dashboard
handoffItems.expectedSignal: Signoff Dashboard page shows 6/6 gates, 175/175 delivery readiness, 20/20 Phase 1 check, 14/14 acceptance, 6/6 safety assertions, and disabled real actions.

handoffItems.title: Open the local Phase 1 mock console
handoffItems.expectedSignal: Console shows MOCK_ONLY safety summary and local navigation.

handoffItems.title: Open the local delivery acceptance page
handoffItems.expectedSignal: Delivery page shows required deliverables, acceptance summary, and safety assertions.

handoffItems.title: Run Phase 1 self-check
handoffItems.expectedSignal: success=true and data.passed=true.

handoffItems.title: Export the local Phase 1 delivery package
handoffItems.expectedSignal: deliveryManifest.summary.missingRequired=0 and acceptanceSummary.passed=true.

handoffItems.title: Render the local acceptance report
handoffItems.expectedSignal: acceptancePassed=true and safetyAssertionsPassed=true.

handoffItems.title: Run handoff checklist contract tests
handoffItems.expectedSignal: pytest passes for tests/test_delivery_handoff.py.

handoffItems.title: Run high-risk MCP handoff contract tests
handoffItems.expectedSignal: pytest passes for tests/test_high_risk_mcp_handoff.py.

handoffItems.title: Run final operation signoff package tests
handoffItems.expectedSignal: pytest passes for tests/test_final_signoff.py.

handoffItems.title: Run operations manual contract tests
handoffItems.expectedSignal: pytest passes for tests/test_operations_manual.py.

handoffItems.title: Run operations Skill pack contract tests
handoffItems.expectedSignal: pytest passes for tests/test_operations_skill_pack.py.

handoffItems.title: Run Standalone Agent delivery contract tests
handoffItems.expectedSignal: pytest passes for tests/test_standalone_agent_delivery.py.

handoffItems.title: Run access entrypoints contract tests
handoffItems.expectedSignal: pytest passes for tests/test_access_entrypoints.py.

handoffItems.title: Run Phase 5 mock baseline tests
handoffItems.expectedSignal: pytest passes for tests/test_phase5_mock_baseline.py.

handoffItems.title: Run real Provider SDK PoC harness tests
handoffItems.expectedSignal: pytest passes for tests/test_real_provider_sdk_poc.py and confirms the harness remains default-disabled.

handoffItems.title: Run real SDK enablement switch design tests
handoffItems.expectedSignal: pytest passes for tests/test_real_sdk_enablement.py and confirms switchDesignReady does not authorize real calls.

handoffItems.title: Run real SDK minimal implementation shell tests
handoffItems.expectedSignal: pytest passes for tests/test_real_sdk_minimal_impl.py and confirms the minimal SDK shell remains default-disabled.

handoffItems.title: Run real SDK dependency and environment gate tests
handoffItems.expectedSignal: pytest passes for tests/test_real_sdk_dependency_env_gate.py and confirms the dependency/env gate remains design-only.

handoffItems.title: Run real SDK dependency install plan tests
handoffItems.expectedSignal: pytest passes for tests/test_real_sdk_dependency_install_plan.py and confirms the install plan remains draft-only.

handoffItems.title: Run real SDK dependency installer audit tests
handoffItems.expectedSignal: pytest passes for tests/test_real_sdk_dependency_installer_audit.py and confirms the installer audit remains disabled.

handoffItems.title: Run real SDK dependency change preview tests
handoffItems.expectedSignal: pytest passes for tests/test_real_sdk_dependency_change_preview.py and confirms the dependency change preview remains disabled.

handoffItems.title: Run real SDK dependency patch proposal tests
handoffItems.expectedSignal: pytest passes for tests/test_real_sdk_dependency_patch_proposal.py and confirms the dependency patch proposal remains disabled.

handoffItems.title: Confirm generated content remains review-gated
handoffItems.expectedSignal: AI-generated Lab, Exam, Grading, and PPT DSL stay WAITING_REVIEW before approval.

handoffItems.title: Confirm real execution remains disabled
handoffItems.expectedSignal: realLlmCalled, realCloudResourceCreated, sandboxExecuted, contestantCodeExecuted, unknownShellExecuted, autoPublishAllowed, and realPublish remain false.

handoffItems.title: Run real SDK dependency apply gate tests
handoffItems.expectedSignal: pytest passes for tests/test_real_sdk_dependency_apply_gate.py and confirms the dependency apply gate remains disabled.

handoffItems.title: Run real SDK dependency final execution confirmation tests
handoffItems.expectedSignal: pytest passes for tests/test_real_sdk_dependency_final_execution_confirmation.py while final confirmation never authorizes execution, task creation, dependency mutation, command execution, dependency install, secret checks, network calls, or real LLM calls.

handoffItems.title: Run real SDK dependency execution task creation tests
handoffItems.expectedSignal: pytest passes for tests/test_real_sdk_dependency_execution_task_creation.py while task creation never persists tasks, queues work, dispatches execution, mutates dependency files, executes commands, installs dependencies, checks secrets, opens network, or calls real LLMs.

handoffItems.title: Run real SDK dependency executor disabled shell tests
handoffItems.expectedSignal: pytest passes for tests/test_real_sdk_dependency_executor_disabled.py while the executor shell never starts executors, creates runs, materializes commands, executes commands, mutates dependency files, installs dependencies, checks secrets, opens network, or calls real LLMs.

handoffItems.title: Run real SDK dependency dry-run evidence tests
handoffItems.expectedSignal: pytest passes for tests/test_real_sdk_dependency_dry_run_evidence.py while dry-run evidence never writes evidence files, persists review records, materializes commands, executes dry-runs, mutates dependency files, installs dependencies, checks secrets, opens network, or calls real LLMs.

handoffItems.title: Run real SDK dependency target resolver tests
handoffItems.expectedSignal: pytest passes for tests/test_real_sdk_dependency_target_resolver.py while target resolver never reads live dependency files, writes target files, generates patches, executes commands, installs dependencies, checks secrets, opens network, or calls real LLMs.

handoffItems.title: Run real SDK dependency readonly snapshot tests
handoffItems.expectedSignal: pytest passes for tests/test_real_sdk_dependency_readonly_snapshot.py while readonly snapshot never reads live dependency files, captures snapshot content, writes snapshot files, persists records, generates patches, executes commands, installs dependencies, checks secrets, opens network, or calls real LLMs.

handoffItems.title: Run real SDK dependency install execution request tests
handoffItems.expectedSignal: Install execution request remains model-only and cannot dispatch executors or install dependencies.

handoffItems.title: Run real SDK dependency install executor disabled tests
handoffItems.expectedSignal: pytest passes for tests/test_real_sdk_dependency_install_executor_disabled.py while the install executor disabled model never dispatches executors, starts executors, creates runs, materializes commands, executes commands, mutates dependency files, installs dependencies, checks secrets, opens network, or calls real LLMs.

readyWhen: All recommended command ids are allowlisted.
Safety assertions stay false for real execution and publish capabilities.
Phase 5 mock baseline freeze is present and reports defaultProvider=mock with real LLM gates documented.
Real Provider SDK PoC harness is present and still blocks SDK imports, secret checks, network calls, generated content, and task creation.
Real SDK minimal implementation shell is present and still blocks SDK imports, secret checks, network calls, generated content, and task creation.
Real SDK dependency/env gate is registered and remains design-only with no SDK install, secret check, or network call.
Real SDK dependency install plan is registered and remains draft-only with no install command, dependency install, package resolution, lockfile change, secret check, or network call.
Real SDK dependency installer audit is registered and remains disabled with no command materialization, dependency install, package resolution, file change, secret check, or network call.
Real SDK dependency change preview is registered and remains disabled with no dependency file writes, diff generation, SDK install, package resolution, secret check, or network call.

Real SDK dependency patch proposal is registered and remains disabled with no patch file writes, patch apply, dependency file changes, diff artifacts, package resolution, secret check, or network call.
notReadyWhen: Any validation command is not in scripts/manifest.json.
Any real provider, real cloud resource, real sandbox, unknown Shell execution, auto publish, or real publish flag becomes true.
Phase 5 mock baseline is missing or a real LLM PoC gate is skipped.
Real Provider SDK PoC harness is missing or treats a blocked SDK path as successful generation.
Real SDK minimal implementation shell is missing or treats a blocked SDK path as successful generation.
Real SDK dependency install plan is missing or treats a draft plan as successful SDK installation work.
Real SDK dependency installer audit is missing or treats audit output as executable installation work.
Real SDK dependency change preview is missing or treats preview output as successful dependency file, diff, install, package resolution, secret check, or network work.
Real SDK dependency patch proposal is missing or treats proposal output as successful patch write, patch apply, dependency file, diff artifact, package resolution, secret check, or network work.
